advancements.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.nozz: Seal a firing nozzle completely and let it blow itself up
Activate a nozzle to convert mixed combustion in the large cauldron into a directed gas jet
The test pad is launch pad!
advancements.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.root: Welcome to the Pigeon Plus addon
anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.configuration.noz: Multiplier for the nozzle screen shake amplitude (0.0 disables shaking)
Radius in blocks around a firing nozzle within which the screen shake is felt
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.anvi:
Pumps fluids and gases with anvil-driven pressure
The flow rate and head are determined by the falling height of the anvil
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.blen: Blends fluid ingredients under a cauldron
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.comp:
Compressed gas, can be liquefied into liquid oxygen
Can be obtained by pumping from the drain port exposed to air
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.feed: Spreads feed or bone meal when pressed by an anvil

Anvil height controls the square working range, up to 9x9
When ripening crops, each crop has a 30% chance to consume bone meal
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.gase: Gas, can be liquefied by continued pumping
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.liqu: Liquid methane-rich fuel for nozzle exhaust
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.mixe:
Very fresh, very delicious
Can be converted into gaseous biogas in a heated cauldron
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.nozz: Forms a directional nozzle exhaust from propellant in a large cauldron

Requires a matching large cauldron propellant reaction
Redstone signal disables the exhaust
The center exhaust can heat blocks, damage entities, and apply momentum
tooltip.anvilcraft_pigeon_plus.item.stas: Freezes one non-player entity or falling block inside its beam

Requires a Frost Metal Block beacon base
Stores incoming damage and momentum while time is stopped
Releases after 30 seconds or 5 hearts of accumulated damage
